activity_summary: You walked the two hundred yards to Leadenhall before you went north. Butter firkins were out on a stall, with a market measure and a mended shutter, and a constable with a bill leaning by them, bored. The price was cried at fourpence. Nobody argued with the bill. You were not looking at a riot. You had not crossed the river.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the edge of the stall and then went home.
